|align="center"|<big>'''THIS PAGE IS FOR LEGENDS INFO ABOUT AHSOKA TANO.'''</big>
This is the talk page of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], which is used to document information about Ahsoka from [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] stories. In order for those stories to make sense, though, we also include all Ahsoka stories from before [[April 25]], [[2014]], the day that the Expanded Universe was rebranded as Legends and became non-canon. We therefore include the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]], allowing the Legends stories in which Ahsoka appeared to fit within the context of the larger ''The Clone Wars'' multimedia project. However, as ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' and [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|''The Clone Wars'': Season Seven]], in which Ahsoka is a character, were released after April 25, 2014, we do not include information from them on this page, as they never existed in a continuity with the Legends stories. Because of that, the Ahsoka story documented on this page ends at "[[The Wrong Jedi]]." '''If you would like to know what happened to Ahsoka after that episode in official canon, please see [[Ahsoka Tano]].'''
